notes.content:
The Almighty has turned away from Nevendaar and its denizens. He is busy thinking about the fate of the world. Above Nevendaar, rent by perpetual wars, a new star flashed out.
What will it bring with it? Who will claim its great power? Immerse in the struggle of four powerful races!
